name: property-tax-system
description: Municipal Property Tax System - DBMS Assignment Project

scripts.db:setup: powershell -Command "Get-Content sql/schema.sql | & 'C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe' -P 3307 -u root; Get-Content sql/sample_data.sql | & 'C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe' -P 3307 -u root"
scripts.db:status: C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe -P 3307 -u root -D property_tax -e "SELECT 'PropertyOwners' AS tbl, count(*) AS total FROM PropertyOwners UNION SELECT 'Properties', count(*) FROM Properties UNION SELECT 'TaxAssessments', count(*) FROM TaxAssessments UNION SELECT 'Payments', count(*) FROM Payments;"

author: Sahil Gupta
